_about: Locked sprite looks for the Retro Bowl sprite card art. Keyed by league player name. skin: pale|light|tan|medium|brown|deep. hair.style: bald|buzz|short|curly|twists|afro|freeform|mohawk|spiky|dreads|shortlocs|braids|long. hair.color: black|darkbrown|brown|auburn|strawberry|blond|dirtyblond|bleached|grey or #hex. facial: none|stubble|jawline|shortbeard|mustache|goatee|chinstrap|beard|fullbeard. accessories: durag|visor|visor-gold|eyeblack|earrings|headband|sleeve-white|sleeve-black|sleeve-team|wristbands|gloves-white|gloves-black|tattoos|armbands. Optional: eyes intense, build normal|big|huge, height normal|tall, pose (any key from the Art lab's Poses strip, e.g. qb-windup, rb-stiffarm, cel-flex, sig-crossed), signature true for owner-requested showcase poses, image (a file in public/data/sprites/ that replaces the generated sprite). Built into public/data/sprites.json by scripts/build_league_data.py.
